entries.description: MCP server for Flipdish restaurant operations: read organizations, properties, sales channels, menus and opening hours, and change menu availability, menu publication and trading hours. Requires a signed-in Flipdish user; the token carries that user's own permissions.
representativeQueries: mark the margherita pizza as sold out for the rest of today
close the Camden store tomorrow for staff training
what are the current opening hours for our Dublin property
publish the latest menu revision to all sales channels

entries.description: Agent skill covering how to resolve a restaurant name into the identifiers a Flipdish menu or hours write actually needs, the snooze timestamp and duration shapes, and the read-confirm-write rule for mutations on live restaurants.
representativeQueries: how do I safely snooze a Flipdish menu item
how do I find the orgId and menuId for a Flipdish restaurant

entries.description: RFC 9727 linkset of Flipdish's public REST APIs, mapping each service to its OpenAPI description and documentation. Covers identity, orders, organizations, menus, sales, operations, audit logs, webhooks, loyalty and subscriptions.
representativeQueries: what public APIs does Flipdish offer
where is the Flipdish webhooks OpenAPI specification
how do I get an access token for the Flipdish API
